result.note: Tested the structural results of the May 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly election and the Governor's role in government formation; skipped the party rhetoric and speculative AIADMK talks.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to party positions in the 234-member Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly after the election results of May 2026:
items: All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (AIADMK) — 47 seats
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Congress won five seats, not 15. TVK's 108 seats left it ten short of the 118 needed for a majority, which is why Congress's support and the AIADMK's 47 seats became decisive.
questions.source: TVK won 108 of 234 seats, ten short of the 118 needed for a majority.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, Vijay of the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam submitted letters of support from MLAs to the Governor of Tamil Nadu to stake a claim to form the government. Who was the Governor?
questions.explain: Vijay submitted letters from 112 MLAs to Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar, who asked him to return with proof of support from 118 MLAs, the majority mark in the 234-seat Assembly.
questions.source: Vijay submitted support letters from 112 MLAs to Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar on Wednesday, who told him to return with proof of 118.
